_appid: Skip Steam: Pokemon is Nintendo first-party and has never been on Steam, so any fuzzy match would be an unrelated game.
long: Pokemon Colosseum drops the series into the desert region of Orre, where there are no wild Pokemon to catch: ex-Team Snagem member Wes steals a Snag Machine and snatches Shadow Pokemon - creatures whose hearts have been artificially closed - away from the criminals using them, then purifies them. Every battle in the story is a Double Battle, fought in full 3D on the GameCube. Alongside the story, Battle Mode is a standalone competitive suite: Battle Now hands one or two players a rental team for an immediate Single or Double Battle at one of four difficulties, and up to four players can enter a Colosseum battle on one console (four players fight 2-on-2). Teams can also be imported from the Game Boy Advance Ruby/Sapphire/FireRed/LeafGreen cartridges over a link cable, which is not reproducible under emulation here.
name: Pokemon Colosseum
short: Snag and purify Shadow Pokemon across the lawless region of Orre in an all-Double-Battle 3D RPG, with a rental-team battle mode for up to four players on one console.
